feedback.message: Treat QNDRF as current leading simplification candidate and PAR only as unresolved. Any claim that Frank benefits from prior experience must distinguish N=0 target-relevant Frank episodic experience from an independent-episode dose ladder and report N_onset/N_robust/N_90/N_harm. Qwen pretrained knowledge is held constant and is not Frank experience. Material q23 questions/results exchange bidirectionally with GO rather than living in a silo.

Implement matched visual/Qwen/EAP differentials plus the Frank experience dose-response factorial. For every N compare QWEN_ONLY, DIRECT_MEMORY_N, PAR_EAP_N, PAR_ACTIVE_N and irrelevant SHAM_N on held-out episodes, separating exact recurrence, state variants, relational transfer, novel entities and conflicting experience. Preserve wrong-seed/stale/shuffled controls and send material runtime/failure results back through GO<->q23 bridge.

Treat EAP/visual memory as context-only evidence. Measure GWT benefit/error over experience dose, including false ignition and memory-induced sensor override; retrieved memory never becomes observed truth. Route q23 findings/questions to GO when they affect whole-system GWT work.

Ensure ClayCode can type PerceptualMemorySeed, visual evidence/feature versions, UnifiedDB basis/hash, EAP selection certificates and ExperienceDoseStudy/result metadata including independence groups and N thresholds. Support compact GO<->q23 message/ref semantics without duplicating full payload context.

Study visual-seed graph activation as derived possibility projection. Dose-response must not inflate N with correlated/near-duplicate episode ancestry. Preserve wrong-seed/shuffled-topology/negative-space controls; graph coherence remains relevance evidence only.

Test EAP as perceptually triggered ActiveAssembly compiler over experience dose. Persist independent episode provenance, current model/mmproj/feature identity and N membership. Compare direct exact/FTS memory and EAP at the same N, include SHAM_N and conflicting/stale experience, report complete end-to-end latency rather than latency-free language.

Keep alternative memory-coupling geometries and experience-response shapes open simultaneously: no effect, finite onset, threshold too high, early overfit, direct-memory dominance, EAP-specific benefit, non-monotonic harm. Collapse branches only from matched dose evidence.

Use lesions/rescues/shuffled graph/wrong seed plus experience-dose interventions to test whether perception-memory coupling contributes causal benefit beyond Qwen pretrained competence and generic memory volume. More memory/coupling is not emergence evidence.

Whole-mesh synthesis must include q23 as a bidirectionally coupled GO specialist branch. PAR remains user-proposed candidate. Treat experience-dose thresholds and negative/no-effect outcomes as architecture knowledge, and keep q23 activity volume separate from global priority.

broadcast_rule: Route only semantically relevant compact deltas/questions; source payload remains indexed and pullable to avoid context spam.
shared_ancestry_rule: These feedback entries do not constitute independent replication. Correlated episode/source ancestry cannot inflate experience N or evidence count.
proposal_guard: AD-Q23-005 originates from a user proposal fused with existing EAP evidence. It remains falsifiable and must not bias architecture selection without matched QWEN_ONLY/direct-memory/SHAM/wrong-seed/stale/shuffled and experience-dose controls.
